title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Same-Day Posting Allowance on Duplicate Mileage
content:
Where a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch carries two mileage postings, the same-day posting allowance is subtracted from the full amount of the later mileage posting before the duplicate is taken back, and the amount remaining is never below zero. The allowance is:

| Posting dates of the two mileage postings | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Both carry the batch's completion date | 0.30 |
| Exactly one carries the completion date | 0.15 |
| Neither carries the completion date | Nothing |

The completion date is the batch's recorded completion date; each posting's date is the posting date shown on that earnings entry.

## Questions answered

**Does the order of the postings matter?** No — only how many of the two are dated the completion date.

**Hypothetical: batch completed 9 April, mileage posted 9 April and again 9 April.** Both dated the completion date: 0.30.

**Hypothetical: batch completed 9 April, mileage posted 9 April and again 11 April.** Exactly one: 0.15; a later posting of 4.35 leaves 4.20 after this allowance.

**Hypothetical: batch completed 9 April, mileage posted 10 April and 12 April.** Neither: nothing.
